text.headline: Timeline of Switzerland
text.text: Major events in the history of Switzerland.

events.headline: Swiss Confederation Founded
events.text: Three Alpine cantons form an alliance for mutual defense.

events.headline: Independence from the Holy Roman Empire
events.text: After the Swabian War, Switzerland gains de facto independence.

events.headline: Battle of Marignano
events.text: A major defeat prompts Switzerland’s long-term neutrality.

events.headline: Treaty of Westphalia
events.text: Swiss independence is formally recognized in European law.

events.headline: Federal Constitution
events.text: Modern Switzerland is established with a democratic constitution.

events.headline: Neutral in the World Wars
events.text: Switzerland maintains neutrality and hosts humanitarian efforts.

events.headline: Joins the United Nations
events.text: Switzerland joins the UN after a referendum.

events.headline: Global Diplomatic Leadership
events.text: The country remains a hub for peace, finance, and climate diplomacy.
